nodes.klein: to mix with water, to hydrate. he mixed with water, watered; he hydrated. was watered, was hydrated. was watered, was hydrated.

nodes.g: to dig, cleave, divide, hew, make, cut out, dig out, cut down, quarry, hewer, mason
to give to drink, irrigate, drink, water, cause to drink water
to take up, catch, pick up (a word)
to be satiated or saturated, have or drink one's fill
Ahumai = "a water reed: brother of waters" grandson of Shobal, descendant of Judah
drawing place of water, place to draw water
Anamim = "affliction of the waters" a tribe of Egyptians
collection, mass, an accumulation of water
Misrephoth-maim = "burnings of water" a place in northern Palestine near Sidon
